title: Beware the Energy Vampire
description:
Resist. Fight. Lose. Submit.

It's so hard to decide what to do in this utterly decadent loop, where I am an ancient immortal vampire who wants to feed on you. But I don't want to suck your blood, no I want your sexual energy. That sustains me. That's why you need femdom hypnosis, because I can use that kink to keep you on edge for me, and turn you into my mindless, constantly aroused thrall.

Isn't that all you really want anyway? So loop this fractionation edging file and lose your mind to me.
